Build a report's RTF from its YAML file

Source: R/output_objects.R
tfl_run_output.Rd

One line to make a report's RTF from the study's files: the report read from spec/outputs/, its ARD built, its content run, its RTF written where tfl_report_path() says. A report with several objects (contents:) has them on its pages as its page.layout: says.

Usage

tfl_run_output(output, dir = ".", overwrite = TRUE)

Arguments

output

A report's id, its YAML file, or a tfl_output().

dir

The study folder.

overwrite

Write over an RTF already there.

Value

The RTF's path, invisibly.

See also

tfl_output_contents(), tfl_report()
